title: My fave subscription box!
text: I love allure subscription box! I also get Ipsy and boxy charm. I did cancel my subscription thru Amazon tho and now I go straight thru allure. The products u receive straight thru allure are a little different than when u subscribe thru Amazon. Either way u get amazing quality products for $23! Just one product u receive in the box out of 5-7 products is worth more than $23! I definitely recommend if u like skincare, makeup and other beauty products.
label: positive
